scope: Shared finite Split triangulation candidate and bounded native controls; not complete M2 acceptance
method: Use a query-expanded native-order hypothesis and cavity triangulation while retaining the current source-area and seam-coverage guards. The GUI and public MCP invoke the same finite Split operation. The build predates only the agent-catalog description update.
nativeControls: The retained convex, concave and cyclic STL facet multisets match the shared operation and the GUI output. Public MCP geometry digests match the GUI in all three browser runs; Undo/Redo, cancellation and binary reopening were checked. These comparisons ignore facet winding and output order, and do not establish arbitrary-input native equivalence.
largeScan: On the original 3691133-face PLY-3 scan the browser performed GUI Split and Extract with source and cutter preserved and Undo/Redo, peaking at 4033089536 job bytes. A direct precise PLY-3 control passed after lazy construction was introduced; earlier candidate versions passed direct PLY-1, PLY-2 and PLY-3 controls. The browser run did not include full artifact download and reopen, and native geometry was not compared for these scans.
review: Independent review identified a private test-fixture path, eager ordering-tree work on distant facets, and nontransactional tree accounting after interruption. The fixture was made portable; two work-budget regressions, query-order independence, cancellation inside expansion and retry accounting were covered. The reviewer found no additional concrete blocker, while general cavity robustness and native equivalence remain unproven.

combinedPreview.result: The five validated Split source files and MCP discovery description were applied after confirming the prior Split files matched the base. A separate browser session loaded the combined preview and its convex control matched the retained native facet set and GUI/public-MCP geometry, including Undo/Redo, cancellation and binary reopen. No page errors; guard peak 880971776 bytes and cleanup confirmed. Other combined-preview changes were preserved.

validation: The final source passed the batched typecheck and 344 Split tests with five skipped. After updating two stale observation tests, the full suite passed 50544 tests with 76 skipped. A rendered convex control matched its retained native facets and had identical canvas pixels after GUI redo; 131 automation, bridge and MCP tests passed after the catalog-description update. All reported guarded runs confirmed cleanup.
limits: The tree and insertion order are inferred from retained static observations and limited fixture behavior. Small-radius native controls with area loss, other native Split workflows, broader lifecycle and the 4 GiB full-download/reopen gate remain open. This change does not close M2.
